raw_case_text: The child underwent tonsillectomy, for a clinical diagnosis of chronic tonsillitis. Histopathological examination of bilateral tonsils revealed caseating and noncaseating epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans giant cells (Figures 1, 2, and 3). Ziehl-Neelsen stain for acid fast bacillus was positive (Figure 4). Features were consistent with a diagnosis of tuberculosis of tonsils.

subjective.chief_complaint: A pediatric patient presenting for elective tonsillectomy for chronic tonsillitis.
subjective.history_of_present_illness: A pediatric patient underwent elective tonsillectomy for a clinical diagnosis of chronic tonsillitis.

objective.advanced_workup: Histopathological examination of bilateral resected tonsils revealed caseating and noncaseating epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans giant cells.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation:
Definitive diagnosis: Tuberculosis of the tonsils (primary tonsillar tuberculosis).
Diagnostic confirmation: Histopathological examination of bilateral tonsils demonstrated caseating and noncaseating epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans multinucleated giant cells, and Ziehl-Neelsen staining was positive for acid-fast bacilli.
Management: Fragment of published case record; post-tonsillectomy antituberculosis chemotherapy detailed in subsequent clinical report.
